text: At Redington, we've built a family of digital platforms. Now, we're bringing them together.
Services as a Platform: Tech Citadel, CloudQuarks, RACE, Velocity and MAAS, plus Hive and Q Intelligence.
Tech Citadel unifies deal registration: over seven hundred partners, and a hundred and fifteen million dollars in pipeline.
CloudQuarks cuts ISV onboarding from six months to six days, and puts every ISV live on the marketplace.
RACE, our AI Centre of Excellence, turns partner AI ambition into practices worth three million a year.
Velocity runs one loyalty program across brands, shifting four and a half million dollars of billing to Redington.
And MAAS delivers marketing as a service, with one point six million dollars in pipeline influence today.
But each one was built separately. Its own login, its own profile, its own data.
Redington One changes that. One login, one profile, one wallet, one feed, built on shared services and one master record. Rolled out in three phases, from single sign-on to one front door.
Every platform connects the same way: one login, one record, one wallet and events, and one front door.
The business case: a two point nine times annual return, with payback in four months.
